title: Add a simple Live Picks page

requirements.text: Add a simple Live Picks page at route "/live" that requires Internet Identity login and displays live picks in a responsive card grid.

quotes: Can you add a simple live picks page

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to "/live" renders a Live Picks page within the main AppLayout.
If the user is not authenticated, the page shows the existing login-required UI state.
Live picks render as a responsive grid of cards (1 column on small screens, increasing on larger breakpoints).
If there are no picks, the page shows a clear empty state message in English.

requirements.text: On the Live Picks page, include basic controls: a text search (player name/team) and a simple status filter (All/Live/Final/Upcoming) that work together to filter the visible picks.

quotes: Can you add a simple live picks page

acceptanceCriteria: Search input filters picks by player name or team (case-insensitive).
Status filter can switch between All, Live, Final, and Upcoming and updates the displayed cards accordingly.
When no picks match filters, show an in-grid empty results message in English.

requirements.text: Fetch Live Picks data from the backend with periodic polling and show standard loading/error states, plus a "Last updated" timestamp when available.

quotes: Can you add a simple live picks page

acceptanceCriteria: While fetching, show a loading state with English text (e.g., "Loading live picks...").
If the query fails, show the existing error UI state.
Live picks refresh automatically on an interval (polling) without requiring manual page reload.
If a last-updated timestamp is available from the backend, display it on the page in human-friendly relative time (English).

requirements.text: Ensure the backend exposes the Live Picks read APIs needed by the Live Picks page: getLivePicks(), getLivePicksLastUpdated(), and getLivePicksDiagnostics().

quotes: Can you add a simple live picks page

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor provides a method to return the current list of LivePick records.
Backend actor provides a method to return the last updated timestamp for live picks.
Backend actor provides a method to return diagnostics for live picks ingestion (including last success/failure timestamps and an error message).
Frontend can call these methods successfully when authenticated via Internet Identity.

constraints: Frontend files in immutablePaths must not be edited (use composition/wrappers instead).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade/state migration is required.
nonGoals: Do not implement real-money wagering, payments, or storing user pick selections on the backend.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity).
Do not add real-time websockets; polling via React Query is sufficient.
